ohun-examples.ifa

Ohun: Audio Simulation

Text-based audio simulation using Irosu I/O and string operations.

Use Case 1: Playlist Manager

// playlist.ifa - Manage a music playlist

ayanmo playlist = [];
ayanmo current = 0;

ese add_track(title, artist) {
    ayanmo track = "[" + title + "] by " + artist;
    ayanmo playlist = Ogunda.fi(playlist, track);
    Irosu.fo("Added: " + track);
}

ese show_playlist() {
    Irosu.fo("=== Playlist (" + Ogunda.iwọn(playlist) + " tracks) ===");
    ayanmo i = 0;
    nigba (i < Ogunda.iwọn(playlist)) {
        ayanmo marker = "  ";
        ti (i == current) {
            ayanmo marker = ">";
        }
        Irosu.fo(marker + " " + (i + 1) + ". " + playlist[i]);
        ayanmo i = i + 1;
    }
}

ese next_track() {
    ayanmo current = current + 1;
    ti (current >= Ogunda.iwọn(playlist)) {
        ayanmo current = 0;
    }
    Irosu.fo("Now playing: " + playlist[current]);
}

// Usage
add_track("Intro", "Artist A");
add_track("Rhythm", "Artist B");
add_track("Finale", "Artist C");
show_playlist();
next_track();
next_track();

Use Case 2: Volume Control

// volume.ifa - Simulate volume adjustment

ayanmo volume = 5;
ayanmo muted = iro;

ese set_vol(level) {
    ayanmo volume = level;
    ti (volume < 0) { ayanmo volume = 0; }
    ti (volume > 10) { ayanmo volume = 10; }
    Irosu.fo("Volume: " + volume + "/10");
}

ese toggle_mute() {
    ayanmo muted = !muted;
    ti (muted) {
        Irosu.fo("Muted");
    } bibẹkọ {
        Irosu.fo("Unmuted, volume: " + volume);
    }
}

ese show_level() {
    ayanmo bar = "";
    ayanmo i = 0;
    nigba (i < volume) {
        ayanmo bar = bar + "#";
        ayanmo i = i + 1;
    }
    nigba (i < 10) {
        ayanmo bar = bar + "-";
        ayanmo i = i + 1;
    }
    Irosu.fo("[" + bar + "] " + (volume * 10) + "%");
}

// Usage
set_vol(7);
show_level();
toggle_mute();
set_vol(3);
show_level();
